facts.text: Caroline has been creating art since she was 17 years old, and she finds it empowering and cathartic.

evidence.quote: Since I was 17 or so. I find it so empowering and cathartic.

facts.text: Melanie has been creating art for seven years and has found her muses in painting and pottery.

evidence.quote: Seven years now, and I've finally found my real muses: painting and pottery.

facts.text: Caroline uses painting and drawing to express her feelings and explore her gender identity, and she credits art with helping her understand and accept herself during her transition.

evidence.quote: Painting and drawing have helped me express my feelings and explore my gender identity. Creating art was really important to me during my transition - it helped me understand and accept myself.

facts.text: Melanie acknowledges that art serves as both a creative outlet and a form of therapy for her.

evidence.quote: It has really helped me out. I love how it's both a creative outlet and a form of therapy.
